author: Schwartz von Mohrenstern, 1860

note.en: A tiny rissoinid snail on the Costa Rican Caribbean catalogue, too small to notice. Size and depth are typical values for the group, not measured locally.
note.es: Un caracol rissoínido diminuto del catálogo del Caribe de Costa Rica, demasiado chico para notarlo. El tamaño y la profundidad son valores típicos del grupo, no medidos localmente.

evidence: Added: not in the original record list for this part

sources.t: Rodríguez Sevilla, Vargas & Cortés 2003, Gastrópodos de la costa Caribe de Costa Rica, Rev. Biol. Trop. 51 (Suppl. 3): 305-399
WoRMS: Rissoina labrosa Schwartz von Mohrenstern, 1860, accepted name

recWhy: Only on the Costa Rican Caribbean snail catalogue (Rodríguez Sevilla et al. 2003); locality not given.
